label: PF Backlog 93
title: Backend: full HIL approval decision model (states + notes + wait/snooze + timeout policy)
body: Approvals currently only support pending/approved/rejected (timeout==reject). Implement the full state set: pending; approved; approved_with_conditions (+conditions); changes (amend -> re-run agent WITH notes, bounded, re-ask); regenerate (re-run agent as-is, bounded); skip (skip agent/stage, continue); rejected (fail stage); abort (stop whole pipeline); expired (timeout policy: wait|fail|skip|approve). Plus WAIT responses: snooze (defer N minutes), wait_further (extend), wait_indefinitely. Interactive default policy = wait indefinitely. Engine: core/pipeline_executor._wait_for_approval_ex() returns {decision, notes, conditions}; _wait_for_approval() stays bool for compat. CLI: approve.py gains --changes/--regenerate/--skip/--abort/--conditions/--snooze/--wait-minutes/--wait-indefinite. agent_execution handles each decision (re-run with feedback for changes; bounded 2). Paired dashboard item: dash:hil-decision-dialog (BI logged next).

dashboard_impact.reason: HIL prompt/approval surface exists (dashboard HIL decision dialog)
